candidates.title: Ab Ripper X Inspired Core Workout 💪 | P90X Recreation
candidates.description:
Get ready to shred your abs with this Ab Ripper X-inspired workout! This is my recreation of the classic P90X core routine by Tony Horton, featuring 12 powerhouse moves to target every part of your core. With exercises like In & Outs, Fifer Scissors, and Mason Twists, you'll get an intense ab burn in just over 20 minutes. A big shoutout to Tony Horton and P90X for the inspiration! No equipment needed.

Please consider donating if you love my channel ~ Thank you! 
👉 https://getfitwithashley.com/donate

💜 Brought to you with love by Ashley, Bo & Trixie

💚 Workout Format: 

12 moves consecutively = 349 Reps

🧡 Exercises: 

1. In & Outs (25)
2. Seated Bicycle Forward (25)
3. Seated Bicycle Backward (25)
4. Seated Crunchy Frog (25)
5. Cross-Leg / Wide-Leg Sit Up (25)
6. Fifer Scissor (25)
7. Hip Rock N' Raise (25)
8. Pulse-Up (Heels to the Heavens) (25)
9. Roll-Up / V-Up Combo (12 sets = 24 reps)
10. Oblique V-Ups (25 Right + 25 Left)
11. Leg Climbs (12 each side)
12. Mason Twist (50 sets)

💛 getfitwithashley.com
